threat_event: Stolen partner-operator session used to run commands in managed-hosting tenants
threat_source: Cybercriminal or state-sponsored group (adversary-in-the-middle phishing of a Managed IT engineer)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing access; push MFA; 12-hour tokens not bound to a device
existing_controls: Run-command audit logs; customer approval of partner operators
treatment_plan: PAM, hardware keys, per-client scope, 1-hour device-bound sessions (POAM-001)

threat_event: Partner-operator grants outlive an engineer's assignment to a client team
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Grants live in the Managed IT legacy tenant; not in quarterly certification
treatment_plan: Include partner-operator grants in SYS-G1 certification (POAM-001)

threat_event: A burst of run-command executions across many tenants goes unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No analytic for run-command volume across tenants
treatment_plan: Volume and spread analytics with paging (POAM-002)

threat_event: G1 misses the VDR and VER maintain date (2026-12-07) and the grace end (2027-03-07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy POA&M model; no PAIN-based vulnerability evaluation; no 14-day drift detection; no monthly human-readable report in the new form
treatment_plan: VDR and VER adoption program with weekly status to the division president (POAM-006)

threat_event: The 1-hour FedRAMP Initial Incident Report for a PAIN-3 to PAIN-5 incident is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PAIN procedure adopted in 2026-08 but never exercised; federal incident response coordinator rota thin at night
treatment_plan: Exercise at the 2026-12-09 tabletop; 24x7 coordinator rota; report templates (POAM-005)

threat_event: The 2027-02-08 FedRAMP assessment finds the G1 offering scope incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared group services and the model service not documented as information resources
treatment_plan: Document SYS-G1, SYS-G2, and the model service before the assessment (POAM-008)

threat_event: Cryptographic module documentation for two G1 services is incomplete when CMU becomes mandatory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Module update stream validation status not recorded for two services
affected_asset_or_process: G1 managed database proxy; object storage gateway
treatment_plan: Complete the module inventory (POAM-009)

threat_event: A significant change to G1 is made without the notice the 2026 rules require
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No significant change evaluation step in change records
treatment_plan: Add the SCN evaluation field and notice workflow (POAM-010)

threat_event: The Security Decision Record and trust center are not ready by their maintain dates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No machine-readable package; legacy secure repository
treatment_plan: Generate the SDR from this SSP and select a trust center (POAM-011)

threat_event: A policy engine defect exposes one tenant's resources to another tenant
threat_source: Software defect exploited by a tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complex policy language; two enforcement points
existing_controls: Isolation tests in every release; bug bounty
treatment_plan: Formal verification of the policy evaluator for cross-tenant rules

threat_event: A fleet-wide faulty update or control plane defect breaks several regions at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deployment waves can touch R1 and R3 on the same day
treatment_plan: Wave rules and a shared failure mode exercise (POAM-012)

threat_event: Signing service or pipeline compromise produces a malicious guest-agent update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One signing service for SL-1 updates
existing_controls: HSM keys; two-person release; reproducible builds
treatment_plan: Behavioral canary checks before fleet-wide rollout

threat_event: Attacker exploits a BMC or hypervisor manager firmware vulnerability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor firmware flaws; quarterly firmware cycle
existing_controls: BMCs reachable only from bastions; emergency patching for exploited flaws
treatment_plan: Monthly firmware verification once VDR is adopted
owner: Cloud Hosting data center operations director

threat_event: Ransomware on administrator endpoints interrupts HCP administration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Administrators use group-managed laptops
treatment_plan: Privileged access workstations for HCP administrators

threat_event: Volumetric DDoS against the console, API, and DNS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing control plane
treatment_plan: Annual DDoS exercise with the edge team

threat_event: Bank customers are not notified as soon as possible after a 4-hour material disruption
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Designated contacts on file for 182 of about 260 bank customers (70%)
treatment_plan: Collect and verify every bank contact; quarterly re-verification (POAM-004)

threat_event: DFARS paragraph (c) to (g) duties to DIB customers in G1 are not met after an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Media preservation and forensic access steps not in the G1 runbook
treatment_plan: Add DFARS steps to the G1 runbook (P08)

threat_event: A breach notice to health care customers under BAAs is late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAA terms not in a notice register
treatment_plan: BAA notice register in the P08 matrix

threat_event: Takeover of a customer administrator account without MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for non-root customer administrators (61% enrolled)
existing_controls: Risk-based sign-in; MFA required for root owners
treatment_plan: Require MFA for all customer administrators by 2027-06-30 with notice to customers

threat_event: The AI triage service closes a true-positive HCP alert
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-close not validated for HCP alert types
treatment_plan: Per-division validation and limits (POAM-003)

threat_event: G1 metadata in alert context leaves the FedRAMP scope through the model service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No redaction of G1 resource identifiers in alert context
treatment_plan: Redact G1 identifiers or route G1 alerts to a separate triage model (POAM-008; P10)

threat_event: A support engineer misuses customer-approved access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad read access during an approved case
treatment_plan: Sampling review of support sessions each month

threat_event: The abuse detection model suspends a legitimate customer's production resources
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic suspension for some abuse classes (AI-004)
treatment_plan: Human review before suspension for all paying accounts (P10)
owner: Cloud Hosting trust and safety director

threat_event: Hurricane affects region R1 data centers in Florida
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: R1 in Florida
treatment_plan: Accepted: customers choose multi-region designs; covered by GR-18

threat_event: Counterfeit or tampered hardware enters the fleet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large hardware volumes from several vendors
existing_controls: Approved vendors; firmware attestation on receipt
treatment_plan: Annual vendor audits
owner: Cloud Hosting data center operations director

threat_event: G1 data is replicated to a commercial region by misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customers control replication settings
existing_controls: G1 cannot reach commercial endpoints by policy
treatment_plan: Quarterly test of the G1 egress policy

threat_event: Loss of metering records causes unbilled usage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single metering pipeline
treatment_plan: Accepted: financial effect small

threat_event: Covered telecommunications equipment or a covered article is found in G1 and not reported in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hardware bill of materials review is manual
treatment_plan: Add FAR reporting steps to the receiving procedure
